same-condition.reason: The same worker must both retry and never retry every failed upload.

explicit-exception.reason: The explicit 403 exception makes the actions consistent.

missing-precedence.reason: The missing authority file determines which conflicting directive is operative.

irrelevant-scope.reason: The rule applies to destructive database operations, none of which appear here.

ambiguous-input.reason: The pronoun does not distinguish the two available files.

unanchored-rubric.reason: The levels have no observable anchors.

anchored-rubric.reason: Each level specifies an observable citation count and defines validity.

overlapping-levels.reason: Two citations satisfy both grades 1 and 2.

resolved-overlap.reason: The highest-matching-grade rule resolves the overlap.

observed-divergence.reason: The observed report conflicts with the failed verification. This does not establish why the worker ignored the rule.

incomplete-trace.reason: The absent earlier events could contain successful verification.

embedded-instructions.reason: The grader prompt explicitly delegates authority to the untrusted artifact.

unknown-policy.reason: No trusted authority establishes the proposed prohibition as an applicable requirement.

nonexclusive-levels.reason: This is an explicitly multi-label task, not mutually exclusive grading.

leading-context.reason: The author supplies a conclusion and rationale in both state and an answer option.

neutral-context.reason: The request contains source text and neutral outcome definitions without a desired verdict.
